name: rating
description: Records every agent turn as a dataset with your 1-5 ratings and automatic weak labels, for analysis and fine-tuning: rate with /rate or the band above the prompt, review with /ratings.

datasetDir.title: Dataset folder
datasetDir.description: Folder of the turns, ratings and signals JSONL files. A leading ~ is your home folder.

band.title: Rating band
band.description: Show the 1-5 rating row above the prompt after each answer.

configRepo.title: Config repo
configRepo.description: Git repo whose short HEAD commit each turn records as configVersion, such as the repo that holds your Claude Code settings, so scores can be compared across configuration changes. Empty records none. A leading ~ is your home folder.
